prompt: 'I just need to become a more disciplined person' is Alex's plan for studying with his phone buzzing beside him, snacks on the desk, and friends chatting nearby. Which critique is strongest?

options.text: His plan targets an identity he cannot act on directly, while the environment keeps generating the distractions; redesigning the setting is a lever he can pull today
Discipline is genetic, so no plan of any kind will help
He should study only when he feels fully disciplined
Friends are the sole problem, so he must drop them

explanation: You cannot directly do 'be disciplined', but you can move the phone, change rooms and agree on quiet time. System changes beat self-image resolutions because they work on tired days too.
